decisive_items: cystic background with “dirty” necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells with cyanophilic cytoplasm
salivary duct carcinoma was initially considered
response.rationale: The cytology results and initial consideration of salivary duct carcinoma support this diagnosis, although mucoepidermoid carcinoma is also a possible consideration due to the cystic background with atypical cells.

rejected.why: The ultrasound description is consistent with pleomorphic adenoma, but the cytology results suggested a more atypical lesion.
The clinical presentation could suggest Warthin tumor, but the cytology results suggested a more suspicious lesion.
